comment: This file contains examples of how you can use Smashable Blocks to make it possible to shoot blocks down.
Don't make behaviours that affect blocks that are super-common in the world e.g. stone or dirt or you can quickly ruin your terrain!
This object will let you shoot cocoa beans off jungle trees - no need to climb up to them.
For convenience, this is written so that only ripe pods break this way.
This one makes bee nests fall down if shot (how rude!)
